result.summary: Type E design at src/design/iss0181-gh512-t010-migration.md VALIDATED. lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 (no BLOCKER/MAJOR). All 4 GH-512 acceptance criteria covered: (a) 184 T010 findings classified (171 CONVERT, 13 RETAIN) with per-site rules S1-S4 and R1-R3, (b) baseline shrinkage arithmetic verified 225 → 54 (13 T010 + 22 T050 + 11 T020 + 2 T060 + 6 T030 = 54, exact match), (c) pre-existing failures (#482/#479/#427/#424/#423/#418/#417) handled via subset-not-superset rule, (d) zig build test-env-verify handled via compile-green criterion #3. TestHarness API claims verified verbatim against helpers.zig: newUuid(self: *TestHarness) bpm.uuid.Uuid at line 862; newUuidString(self: *TestHarness, allocator: std.mem.Allocator) ![]u8 at line 874 — signatures match design exactly, no new API required. Type E rules respected: prose + signatures + pseudocode + data-flow; no SQL DDL committed to migrations/, no function bodies, no schema changes. 13 platform-admin RETAIN sites in design table match diagnosis retention_reasons.locations exactly (same 13 files, same lines). 5-batch migration order has event_store_integration_test.zig first (59 sites). Spot-checked S1/S2 patterns against event_store_integration_test.zig lines 100-250 (TC-ES-01-01 and TC-ES-02-01): the literal-then-parseUuid pattern for both inst_id and actor_id matches the S1 (h.newUuid() for binary) + S2 (h.newUuidString(alloc); defer alloc.free) substitution rules; defer cleanupInstance ordering risk correctly flagged in design §Risks. Only one MINOR non-blocking observation: design Batch 2/3 grouping of oidc15_realm_deletion_test.zig (design = Batch 2 with 5 files / 40 sites; diagnosis = Batch 3 with 4 files / 21 sites) differs from diagnosis recommended_batch_order, but the design groups by total site count (5-file batch = 40) and the diagnosis groups by subsystem; both produce valid intermediate states, no coverage gap, not a blocker.
